revision_kind: Exploratory profile continuation, not a product/configuration revision
coordinates: mm; X lateral, Y insertion into host mouth Y=0, Z up; rotate about Y(roll), X(pitch), Z(yaw), then translate
scope: Reference rigid geometry, contact-derived frictionless quasistatic ideal slide constraints. No spring/force/friction/latch or product proof.

shell.meaning: Outer envelope for interference/potential contact only, not guaranteed material

carriage.rib_revision: L-shaped reference rib routes below the key instead of crossing it; 0.1mm nominal lateral clearance is NOT a tolerance or strength qualification

ideal_constraints: Each cam, rib and door is one rigid CAD solid with one ideal translation DOF; no physical bearing validation.
Return bias chooses smallest free slider position continuously reachable from previous position. Input-induced overlap may push toward opening boundary; stroke exhaustion is a reference jam.

Forbidden displacement intervals come from SAT configuration space of actual convex shapes, not key identity or d+lead. Input Y is still externally prescribed, and sampled increments do not prove continuous dynamics.
Any frame/door/rib interpenetration stops the sampled path before recording it as reachable. Touching/tolerance is counted, not silently declared clear.
Potential contact includes all d>=0 and touching/intersection of the shell outer envelope with a conservative contact region for d<0. This does not identify real USB contacts.
derived_profile_changes: Longer collar remains above approved12.5mm minimum; trial probes7.5/8.6mm test controlled reference collar instead of unknown USB shell material. Keep original1/2mm probes as baseline. New cam/rib/relief/profile values are study outputs, not adopted hardware/MPN/material choices.
unmodelled: real pawl/endpoint latching and bridge disconnection
common-frame fracture, material loss and certified tamper resistance
real contact/material tolerances or continuous unsampled pose trajectories
